skills.name: SMA crossover (Backtrader quickstart style)
skills.description: Backtrader's canonical first strategy: long when the fast SMA crosses above the slow one, close on the cross back. Long only, no stop.

skills.name: Close vs SMA (Backtrader sample style)
skills.description: The simplest signal in Backtrader's samples: long while the close crosses above its SMA, out when it crosses below.

skills.name: MACD with ATR stop (Backtrader sample style)
skills.description: MACD line crossing its signal above a rising trend filter, protected by an ATR stop, as in Backtrader's MACD sample.
